themes_detail.label: Construction boom straining services
themes_detail.summary: General Construction/Plumbing complaints surged to 47 THIS WEEK—a 192% spike above the 16.1-per-week baseline (z-score: 5.6)—signaling potential coordination failures or project overload affecting residents as 655 DOB permits remain active in the district.
evidence: 47 construction/plumbing complaints THIS WEEK vs. 16.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (192% increase, z-score: 5.6)
655 active DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (340 alterations, 146 new buildings, 79 ALT-CO filings)
Repeated CB budget requests for 'additional building inspectors' suggest chronic enforcement gap
reporting_angles: Interview DOB about complaint handling and inspector capacity during construction surge
Map 655 active permits against 311 construction complaint clusters to identify problem zones

themes_detail.label: Sanitation crisis accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Missed garbage collection complaints jumped 576% last week (38 complaints vs. 5.6 weekly baseline, z-score: 4.97), while Residential Disposal complaints spiked 643% (13 complaints last week vs. 1.8 average, z-score: 6.86), indicating a potential system failure or service reduction.
evidence: 38 Missed Collection complaints last week vs. 5.6 weekly average (576% increase, z-score: 4.97)
13 Residential Disposal complaints last week vs. 1.8 weekly average (643% increase, z-score: 6.86)
7 Rodent complaints last week vs. 2.5 weekly average (180% increase, z-score: 4.5)—direct downstream effect of disposal failures
reporting_angles: Contact DSNY to determine if staffing shortages, route changes, or equipment failures triggered the spike
Document resident impact: garbage accumulation, pest infestation, street conditions worsening

themes_detail.label: Dumpster violations spike
themes_detail.summary: Dumpster Complaint reports hit a 700% spike 2 weeks ago (4 complaints vs. 0.5 baseline, z-score: 4.95), suggesting either increased illegal dumping, poor maintenance, or a new enforcement effort catching violations residents had been reporting informally.
evidence: 4 Dumpster Complaint reports 2 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 4.95)
Coincides with broader disposal crisis (Missed Collection UP 576%, Residential Disposal UP 643% in same period)
Convergence with rodent spike suggests environmental conditions deteriorating
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings or commercial areas have been cited for dumpster violations
Interview residents about overflow, odor, and pest problems tied to dumpster maintenance

themes_detail.label: Traffic complaints spike unexpectedly
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints surged 500% last week (6 complaints vs. 1.0 weekly baseline, z-score: 5.77), coinciding with a ULURP rezoning notice at 39th Street & New Utrecht Avenue—early signal that development activity or road configuration changes may be disrupting flow.
evidence: 6 Traffic complaints last week vs. 1.0 weekly average (500% increase, z-score: 5.77)
Active ULURP rezoning noticed at 39th Street & New Utrecht Avenue (ZM milestone: Prepare Filed Land Use Application)
Construction spike (47 complaints THIS WEEK) may be contributing to congestion
reporting_angles: Connect traffic spike to 39th Street/New Utrecht rezoning—are construction impacts or temporary road closures in play?
Determine if complaints cluster geographically around ULURP site

themes_detail.label: Bike/vendor complaint anomaly
themes_detail.summary: Bike/Roller/Skate and Mobile Food Vendor complaints each hit 2,300% spikes (3 complaints last week vs. 0.1 baseline for both, z-score: 8.69 each)—extreme outliers that may reflect one-off events, data entry errors, or an emerging street use conflict worth validating.
evidence: 3 Bike/Roller/Skate complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average (2,300% increase, z-score: 8.69)
3 Mobile Food Vendor complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average (2,300% increase, z-score: 8.69)
Both baseline averages extremely low (0.1/week), making percentage spikes statistically extreme but potentially unreliable
reporting_angles: Verify 311 data: confirm whether these are genuine complaints or data anomalies
If genuine, investigate what triggered sudden interest in regulating street vendors or skaters (event, enforcement sweep, seasonal influx)
